description_expanded: Welcome to Grayton Time, a delightful three-bedroom vacation home in the heart of Grayton Beach that comfortably sleeps eight happy guests. Just a short stroll from the sugary shores and the historic village center, this spot offers the ultimate mix of relaxation and adventure. The village sits alongside the sparkling Gulf waters and the unique Western Lake , a coastal dune lake that's a natural gem rarely found anywhere else in the world. Picture creek-like estuaries meandering through the dunes, blending saltwater and freshwater to create a magical habitat for wildlife, fish, and waterfowl. With a village dock nearby, you can paddleboard, kayak, or fish to your heart's content. Grayton Time welcomes you with charming verandas at the front and back of this raised beach home, complete with parking underneath. Step inside to a bright, open living area featuring a soaring white-paneled cathedral ceiling and rich honey-toned hardwood floors. Two comfy coastal-style couches and patterned accent chairs surround a charming gas Franklin Stove and a large wall-mounted flatscreen TV. Dine in style at the natural hardwood table with its mix of six coastal-inspired chairs, or whip up a meal in the state-of-the-art kitchen with shiplap walls, creamy white cabinetry, and colorful backsplash tile. Glass doors lead to a screened veranda, perfect for cozy outdoor living and dining. Head down the outdoor staircase to discover a patio with a plunge pool, a ping pong table, a covered dining area, a wet bar with a wine cooler, and a full bath for washing off sandy feet. The plush primary and guest bedrooms each feature king-size beds and access to a lovely screened porch. The primary bedroom boasts an ensuite bath with a walk-in shower, while a hall bath with a walk-in shower serves the guest quarters, including a bedroom with two queen-size beds. Beyond the beach and lake, you're just steps away from Grayton Beach's vibrant village center. The famous Red Bar offers great food, craft cocktails, wine, beer, and nightly live music. Across the street, the Zoo Gallery showcases unique art, jewelry, and colorful coastal furnishings by artists from across the country. Next door, Tribe Kelley Surf Post features chic coastal clothing and handpicked accessories. A short walk away, Chiringo serves up tapas, seafood, and seasonal entertainment. For more fun, AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar is only a minute's drive away, with oysters, Gulf seafood, and lively bands every night. You're also close to Seaside and Santa Rosa Beach Village Center at Gulf Place , where you can enjoy outdoor concerts and festivals year-round. The variety of nearby attractions is sure to keep you excited throughout your stay. Book your stay at Grayton Time today and dive into the perfect blend of historic charm and modern comfort in enchanting Grayton Beach!
